explanation: This shows the Fuzzilli integration in V8. Fuzzilli is a fuzzing framework integrated into V8 through an extension and coverage tracking. The key finding is that there is NO direct connection between Fuzzilli and JSGenerator implementation. Fuzzilli provides general fuzzing infrastructure (crash triggering, coverage tracking, REPRL mode) but does not have generator-specific functionality. JSGeneratorObject is a V8 internal class for implementing JavaScript generators, and Fuzzilli interacts with V8 at a higher level through the d8 shell and coverage instrumentation.
